import re

async def act(page):
    # Get the complementary section using its role
    complementary = page.get_by_role('complementary')
    
    # Get all links within the complementary section
    all_links = complementary.get_by_role('link')
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    
    # Filter links to only those that are posts (URL contains '/?p=')
    post_links = []
    for i in range(link_count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        url = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if url and '/?p=' in url:
            post_links.append(link)
    
    # Check if we have at least 3 post links
    if len(post_links) < 3:
        raise ValueError(f'Only {len(post_links)} post links found in complementary section, need at least 3')
    
    # Get the third post link (index 2)
    third_post_link = post_links[2]
    
    # Extract title from link text
    title = await third_post_link.text_content()
    title = title.strip()
    # Remove the bullet character '' if present
    if title.startswith(''):
        title = title[1:].strip()
    
    # Extract URL of the third post
    url = await third_post_link.get_attribute('href')
    
    # Find the publish date by matching URL with date links
    # Get all links on the page that have text matching a date pattern
    date_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text=re.compile(r'\w+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}'))
    date_count = await date_links.count()
    publish_date = 'Unknown'
    for i in range(date_count):
        date_link = date_links.nth(i)
        date_url = await date_link.get_attribute('href')
        if date_url == url:
            publish_date = await date_link.text_content()
            publish_date = publish_date.strip()
            break
    
    # Return the result as a string
    result = f'Title: {title}, Publish Date: {publish_date}'
    return result

import re

async def act(page):
    # Get the complementary section using its role
    complementary = page.get_by_role('complementary')

    # Get all links within the complementary section
    all_links = complementary.get_by_role('link')
    link_count = await all_links.count()

    # Filter links to only those that are posts (URL contains '/?p=')
    post_links = []
    for i in range(link_count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        url = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if url and '/?p=' in url:
            post_links.append(link)

    # Check if we have at least 3 post links
    if len(post_links) < 3:
        raise ValueError(f'Only {len(post_links)} post links found in complementary section, need at least 3')

    # Get the third post link (index 2)
    third_post_link = post_links[2]

    # Extract title from link text
    title = await third_post_link.text_content()
    title = title.strip()
    # Remove the bullet character '' if present
    if title.startswith(''):
        title = title[1:].strip()

    # Extract URL of the third post
    url = await third_post_link.get_attribute('href')

    # Find the publish date by matching URL with date links
    # Get all links on the page that have text matching a date pattern
    date_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text=re.compile(r'\w+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}'))
    date_count = await date_links.count()
    publish_date = 'Unknown'
    for i in range(date_count):
        date_link = date_links.nth(i)
        date_url = await date_link.get_attribute('href')
        if date_url == url:
            publish_date = await date_link.text_content()
            publish_date = publish_date.strip()
            break

    # Return the result as a string
    result = f'Title: {title}, Publish Date: {publish_date}'
    return result
